title: Person: Mr Dedalus
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Dedalus

anchor.prefix:
I can’t help thinking of our friend Christopher manufacturing...

 He broke into a fit of laughter and coughing and added:

 —...manufacturing that champagne for those fellows.
anchor.suffix:
laughed loudly.

 —Is it Christy? he said. There’s more cunning in one of those warts on his bald head than in a pack of jack foxes.

 He inclined his head, closed his eyes, and,
